en.html:
What happened at Hachiman Shrine on the day of the Sword-Offering visit. What followed when we were taken to Horigoe in Izu. Being separated from Kageaki, locked away, then rescued and brought here, to Kenchouji—

Whatever I thought should be told, I had told. That much, at least, was done.

Listening to me were:

れて<ruby>建朝寺<rt>ここ</rt></ruby>へ来るまでのこと――

　話すべきと思えたことは全て話した。

en.html: Akitaka Kikuchi, the man Kageaki called Chief. He had once lived with the Minato household, so 'Muramasa' was no new business to him. Apart from Kageaki, he was among the people most familiar to me in this age.

ja.html:
景明に『署長』と呼ばれていた男、菊池明堯。
　昔は湊斗家に身を置いていたため〝村正〟について
も良く知る、景明を別とするなら私にとってこの時代
では最も馴染みのある人物のひとり。

en.html: His Highness Prince Haruhiro of Maidono. The present emperor's younger brother, I was told. Today only I had met him, but apparently he and the Chief had been helping our pursuit of Silver Star all along—openly and behind the scenes, both.

ja.html:
<ruby>舞殿宮春煕親王<rt>まいどののみやはるひろしんのう</rt></ruby>殿下。
　今上の帝の弟君だという。会うのは今日が初めてだ
けれど、景明と私の銀星号追跡を署長と二人で陰日向
に<ruby>援<rt>たす</rt></ruby>けてくれていたらしい。
ja.text:
舞殿宮春煕親王まいどののみやはるひろしんのう殿下。
　今上の帝の弟君だという。会うのは今日が初めてだ
けれど、景明と私の銀星号追跡を署長と二人で陰日向
に援たすけてくれていたらしい。

en.html: Kanae Ootori and her chamberlain, whom I knew somewhat. Yamato people, serving in a foreign army, stationed in Yamato. Country of origin and country of duty, same; allegiance had gone abroad. I could not quite understand the arrangement. GHQ, occupation army... something like that, they had said.

いう、何だか良くわからない二人。<ruby>ＧＨＱ<rt>じーえいちきゅー</rt></ruby>とか進駐軍
とか言っていたか……。

Ichijou Ayane, also known to me from following Kageaki about. Ayane was the family name, yes; I had it backward.

For some reason she kept looking at me with something strangely complicated in her eyes. What all was sitting behind that look, I could not tell.

en.html:
Finally, the warrior calling himself Kuronose Douji. Apparently he led one of the forces opposing the Rokuhara shogunate. He had crept into Chachamaru's residence and landed in trouble; Kageaki and I had saved him. Back he came, and this time he saved me.

He alone seemed to have known nothing about Silver Star. My account had left him quite bewildered. Silent behind his mask, he appeared to be trying to digest it. There was plenty to chew.

ja.html:
最後に、<ruby>黒瀬童子<rt>くろのせどうじ</rt></ruby>と称する武人。
　どうも六波羅幕府に敵対する一勢力の頭目のような
立場らしい。茶々丸の館に忍び込んで窮したところを
景明と私に救われ、再びやって来て今度は私を救った。

　彼だけは銀星号について何も知らなかったらしく、
私の話を聞いてだいぶん困惑した様子を見せている。
　覆面の中で押し黙り、情報を咀嚼するふうだった。

en.html:
Prince Maidono"...Arre. Now this is a surprise..."
Prince Maidono"So much surprise, where to begin being surprised? That itself I cannot decide. Chief?"
Chief"...Yes."
Prince Maidono"This young lady being the tsurugi Muramasa, that part I heard from the Chief. So let us say I have accepted it. Accepted on paper, mind you; the rest of me has not caught up."
Prince Maidono"Kageaki has been brainwashed by Silver Star's power and joined the shogunate's side?"
Muramasa"..."
Sayo"From what we have heard, however, treating Chachamaru and Rokuhara as one party would not necessarily be correct."
Kanae"Yes. We should understand it this way: the connection to Silver Star is with the Lord of Horigoe, not the shogunate. And now she has brought Kageaki into her circle as well..."
Ichijou"What the hell is that kamini planning?"
Sayo"That, now... She appears to intend something considerable, in cooperation with Silver Star."
Kanae"It does not seem as simple as using Silver Star in the shogunate's power struggles, or in a war against the occupation forces. Something more... altogether different."
Chief"Agreed. Among the Four Great Kubo, the other three—Doushin Yusa, Raichou Imagawa and Shishiku Ootori—will hardly be short of private ambitions."
Chief"But Rokuhara is the foundation on which those ambitions stand. That is why they can still unite against an outside enemy. Chachamaru Ashikaga, however—"
Prince Maidono"Her foundation seems to be somewhere else entirely, na."
Chief"Yes."
Kanae"..."
Sayo"..."
Kuronose"..."

Everybody fell silent, as if this much they had agreed upon. No answer was presenting itself, apparently.

And what could I say? I had told them about Chachamaru Ashikaga's connection to Silver Star, but her purpose was just as unknown to me.

Really... what was she wanting?

ja.html:
申し合わせたように、皆が沈黙した。
　誰も疑問の答を出せなかったのだろう。

　足利茶々丸と銀星号の繋がりを教えた私にしてから
が、茶々丸の目的にさっぱり見当を付けられないのだ
から仕方ない。
　本当に――何を望んでいるのか。

en.html:
His Highness and the Chief briefly explained what had happened since the Sword-Offering visit. Silver Star had made Hachiman Shrine disappear, so His Highness had moved here to Kenchouji.

The temple had close ties to the Ashikaga clan controlling the shogunate. And yet, secretly, many of its monks favored the imperial court. Such was the arrangement: under this roof, His Highness and his faction could act more vigorously than before.

One result was contact with survivors of the Okabe clan, destroyed after its rebellion against the shogunate. The man bringing them together was Kuronose Douji. Here only, sitting with us.

His Highness and the Chief briefly explained what had happened since the Sword-Offering visit. Silver Star had made Hachiman Shrine disappear, so His Highness had moved here to Kenchouji.

The temple had close ties to the Ashikaga clan controlling the shogunate. And yet, secretly, many of its monks favored the imperial court. Such was the arrangement: under this roof, His Highness and his faction could act more vigorously than before.

One result was contact with survivors of the Okabe clan, destroyed after its rebellion against the shogunate. The man bringing them together was Kuronose Douji. Here only, sitting with us.

ja.html:
宮様は署長と一緒に、奉刀参拝から今までのことを
かいつまんで説明してくれた。
　八幡宮が銀星号によって<ruby>消えて<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>しまったので、宮様
の居はこの建朝寺に移されたこと……。

　建朝寺は幕府を牛耳る足利一門と縁深いが、それで
いて朝廷に心を寄せる僧も実は密かに多いため、宮様
を中心とする一派は以前より活発な行動がとれるよう
になったこと……。

　その成果の一つが、幕府に反逆して滅ぼされた岡部
一族の残党との接触であり、彼らをまとめているのが
ここにいる黒瀬童子であること……。

Prince Maidono"Can wait? Arre, Kikuchi—"
Kanae"...Well... If she is using him, that does also suggest she will not kill him for the moment."
Sayo"Depending on what use, and how. Those small details."
Chief"The Lord of Horigoe's intentions are a concern, but we must not forget the shogunate's actions as a whole. At present, that is more urgent."
Chief"The shogunate is pressing the imperial court to appoint Kuniuji Ashikaga as Lord General. If they succeed, Yamato will probably face a decisive turning point."
Kanae"...Yes. There is almost no doubt that GHQ is planning military action for that very moment."
Sayo"A new weapon appears to be ready. One intended to settle the matter."
Chief"Rokuhara and the occupation forces. For us, neither side winning is desirable."
Chief"Nor, of course, a war that settles nothing while grinding down the country and its people."
Kuronose"...They must not be allowed to fight at present. So we must obstruct Shirou Ashikaga's appointment as Lord General. Is that it?"
Chief"Exactly."
Prince Maidono"We are keeping in touch with Kyoto, asking them to stretch the proceedings somehow, anyhow... How long the thing can stretch, though, who knows?"
Chief"Not long, I expect. While we still have time, we must work on the ministers within the shogunate—"
Muramasa"..."

舞殿宮「後回しって、菊池ぃ」
香奈枝「……まぁ……利用されているということは 差し当たって命を奪われる危険はないという ことでもありますけれど」
さよ「何にどう利用されるのかにもよりますなァ」
署長「堀越公方の目論見も気掛かりですが、幕府 全体の動きも忘れてはなりません。 　今はこちらの方が差し迫っています」
署長「幕府が朝廷に働き掛けている、足利邦氏へ の大将領宣下……。 　これが成功した時、おそらく大和の情勢は 決定的な節目を迎えます」
香奈枝「……ええ。 　その時機に合わせて、ＧＨＱが軍事行動を 企画しているのはほぼ疑いありません」
さよ「決定力となる新兵器が用意されている模様 でございます」
署長「六波羅と進駐軍。 　我々としてはどちらの勝利も望ましくない」
署長「無論、両者の戦争が決着せず、いたずらに 国土と国民を疲弊させてゆくのも」
黒瀬「……今は両者を争わせるべきではない。 　従って、足利四郎への大将領宣下を妨害し なくてはならぬ、ということか」
署長「そうです」
舞殿宮「京都と連絡を取り合って、何とかかんとか 引き伸ばしてもろうてるけどなァ……。 　いつまで続けられるかはわからんねえ」
署長「長くはもたないでしょう。 　今のうちに幕閣内への工作を進め――」
村正「…………」
